title.narrative: Civil Society in Uganda Support Programme II (CUSP II)

description.narrative: Contract related to: Civil Society in Uganda Support Programme II (CUSP II) - The Overall Objective of CUSP II is, reduced poverty through improved democratic governance. Based on pro-poor and human rights-based strategies, the Action will support progress towards a more just, peaceful and inclusive Ugandan society. The Specific Objective of this Action is strengthened civil society engagement for the enhanced adherence of development processes to democratic governance principles and leaving no one behind.
